purpose: Development-only decoder thread-limit intervention justified by observed CPU profile and pinned source. No final outcomes used.
source_observation: Transformers5.8.1 read_video_torchcodec explicitly passes num_ffmpeg_threads=0; four independent workers run under eight-CPU affinity. torchcodec documents one decoder thread for parallel decoder instances.
selection: Same first32 target SHA256 keys as prior preparation canary; no score-based selection.
paired_order: Hash-key parity counterbalances candidate/control ordering per target. Both use exact seek and unchanged frame sampling.
correctness_gate: Every candidate tensor/token/label must equal a separate raw native default-thread replay and the qualified prepared reference; preserve CPU RNG and reject CUDA initialization.
scope: Single development canary; per-target times are not independent full-pipeline repetitions. Cannot revise the locked1990s final cold component or establish release speed by itself.
